subject: general
question: What is the full form of UNESCO?

options.text: Union National Employment Scheme Concerning Organization
United Nations Economic, Social and Communal Organization
United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization focuses on everything from teacher training to helping improve education worldwide to protecting important historical and cultural sites around the world.
 
• UNESCO preserves 1073 World Heritage sites in 167 countries.
 
• UNESCO's Headquarters in Paris, France
 
• The Organization has 193 Members and 11 Associate Members.
 
• There are a total of 43 world heritage site in India:
 
• The most recent sites listed were Santiniketan and the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas, in 2023.​
 
• The most recent addition in the list of UNESCO WHS is Charaideo Maidams, Assam.
